_about: Public-domain Daniel Dana (1771-1859), Congregational minister of Newburyport and President of Dartmouth College, for the Word Hoard: The Deity of Christ (1810), Evangelical Preaching is Rational Preaching, Objections against the Gospel Refuted, the 1837 Massachusetts election sermon, Letters to Professor Stuart on his essay on sin, and The New Song. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 89 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

ddana-deity-christ: The deity of Christ. A sermon delivered July 31, 1810, before the Haverhill association; and published at their request (Newburyport, Printed by W. & J. Gilman, booksellers and stationers, no. 2, Middle-street, 1819)
ddana-evangelical-preaching: Evangelical preaching is rational preaching, vol. c.1 (Concord, N.H., Printed by Isaac Hill, 1826)
ddana-objections-refuted: Objections against the gospel refuted : a sermon preached March 4, 1829, at the installation of the Rev. John Brown, D.D. as pastor of Pine Street Church, Boston (Boston : T.R. Marvin, Printer, 1829)
ddana-election-1837: A sermon delivered at the annual election on Wednesday, January 4, 1837, before His Excellency Edward Everett, governor, His Honor George Hull, lieutenant governor, the honorable Council, and the legislature of Massachusetts (Boston, Dutton and Wentworth, Printers to the State, 1837)
ddana-letters-stuart: Letters to the Rev. Professor Stuart : comprising remarks on his essay on sin, published in the American biblical repository for April and July, 1839 (Boston : Printed by Crocker & Brewster, 1839)
ddana-new-song: The New song : a sermon, delivered in Bowdoin-Street Church, Boston (Boston : Crocker and Brewster, 1849)

_excluded.ddana-other: Baptology (1860), by Daniel Dana Jr.; his Washington discourse (bound in a many-author volume); collections that only include a sermon of his
